final: WITH j AS (SELECT u.acctscope AS scope, f.feerate - f.rebrate AS net FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp), s AS (SELECT scope, AVG(net) AS avg_net, COUNT(net) AS n FROM j GROUP BY scope) SELECT scope, avg_net, n, avg_net - (SELECT AVG(avg_net) FROM s) AS diff_from_mean_of_avgs FROM s ORDER BY scope
